name: Hartalega Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hartalega的主要公告集中在季度业绩、股东大会及公司秘书变更，未披露任何业务板块的产能扩张、新业务进入、缩减或出售事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长19.5%，净利润同比增长79.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, Hartalega's announcements mainly covered quarterly results, general meetings and a change of company secretary, with no disclosed capacity expansion, new business entry, reduction or divestment in any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-09-30) revenue grew 19.5% year-on-year and net profit grew 79.3% year-on-year.
